title: The Historic Constitution vs. Codification
grammar: The Doctrine of the Holy Crown and Unwritten Constitutionalism
goal: I can explain what the történeti alkotmány was and how it differed from a written constitution.
I can say what the Szent Korona-tan claimed about the king and the nation.
I can use words such as szokásjog, jogfolytonosság and kartális alkotmány.
